buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 5 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 5. Purchase Preference (State) Bid reserved for MSE from the State of Bid Inviting Authority: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises from the State of Bid Inviting Authority having valid Udyam Registration and whose credentials are validated online through Udyam Registration portal. If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible to participate in this bid. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service, and Buyer will decide eligibility based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 6. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the

date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 9. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) PROCUREMENT AND SUPPLY OF CHARCOAL 1. Acceptance of Bid Conditions The bidder shall carefully read and comply with all technical specifications, delivery requirements, quantity requirements, and contractual conditions mentioned in the GeM bid. Submission of the bid shall constitute acceptance of the applicable bid conditions. 2. Mandatory Bid Documents The bidder shall upload all documents specifically required under the bid, including applicable business re gistration, GST details where applicable, product specifications, and declarations. Missing mandatory docu ments may result in rejection in accordance with the bid conditions and applicable GeM rules. 3. Technical Compliance The offered material must strictly conform to the product description and technical specifications stated in the bid. Any deviation must be clearly disclosed in the technical offer. Material not meeting the specified r equirements shall not be accepted. 4. Quality Assurance The supplied charcoal/hard coke shall be of consistent quality and free from stones, soil, excessive dust, a nd other foreign materials. Moisture, ash content, fixed carbon, volatile matter, size, and other relevant pa rameters shall comply with the specifications expressly stated in the bid. 5. Laboratory Test Report Where justified by the procurement requirements, the bidder shall provide a genuine test report issued by a competent laboratory for the relevant product and parameters. The report must be traceable to the teste d sample or consignment where applicable. False, altered, or misleading documents may be dealt with un der applicable GeM rules and law.

6. Delivery Commitment The bidder shall confirm its ability to supply the full ordered quantity within the delivery schedule stated in the GeM contract. Partial delivery shall be permitted only where expressly allowed or approved under the contract. 7. Quantity Verification The delivered quantity shall be verified at the designated delivery location using the applicable weighing p rocedure. Payment shall be based on the accepted quantity in accordance with the contract. 8. Inspection and Quality Rejection The buyer may inspect the goods upon delivery and verify compliance with the bid specifications. Non-conf orming goods may be rejected, replaced, or otherwise dealt with under the applicable contract provisions. 9. Transportation and Safe Handling The supplier shall arrange transportation and safe handling in accordance with the delivery terms. The ma terial shall be protected against contamination, avoidable spillage, and excessive exposure to moisture du ring transit. 10. Supplier's Undertaking The bidder shall submit an undertaking, if required by the bid, confirming that it has reviewed the specifica tions, possesses the capacity to fulfil the order, and will supply the material in accordance with the contrac t. 11. Contractual Default Failure to deliver within the contractual period, supply of material that repeatedly fails inspection, or submi ssion of false documents may result in remedies available under the GeM contract and applicable rules, fol lowing the prescribed procedure. 12. Applicable Rules The GeM General Terms and Conditions, applicable bid provisions, and relevant statutory requirements sh all govern the procurement. In the event of a conflict, the applicable contractual and GeM provisions shall prevail. 13. Uniform Application All technical, documentary, and performance requirements shall be objectively related to the procurement and applied uniformly to eligible bidders. No bidder shall be excluded except on grounds permitted by the bid and applicable rules. Documents to ask from bidders on GeM ​1. Udyam/MSME certificate, firm registration certificate, partnership deed, or incorporation certificate, as a pplicable to the bidder's legal constitution.

2. Valid GST registration, where applicable under law and the bid requirements. 3.PAN details consistent with the bidder's registration and applicable tax records. 4. A genuine laboratory report for the relevant charcoal or hard coke parameters, such as ash, moisture, fi xed carbon, volatile matter, and size, as specified in the bid. 5. A signed declaration confirming that the offered product meets every required technical specification. 6. Confirmation of the ability to supply the full ordered quantity within the stipulated delivery period and at the specified destination. 7. A signed declaration regarding blacklisting or debarment, in the form and scope stated in the bid and pe rmitted by applicable rules. 8. Declaration that the bidder is not under liquidation, insolvency proceedings, or similar circumstances, w here such a condition is included in the bid. 9. Signed and stamped acceptance of the applicable Additional Terms and Conditions, where required. 10. Turnover certificate, audited financial statements, or past supply orders/performance certificates, only where relevant, proportionate, and permitted by the applicable GeM bid rules. 11. The bidder/OEM should be a reputed manufacturer for Charcoal/Hard coke items or its authorised deal er and should have set-up in North India for more than 3 to 5 years. The proper documentary proof (i.e. Fa ctory License, EPF Registration, ESIC Registration, GST Registration) should be enclosed with tender bid. 12. The bidder/OEM shall have Average Annual Turnover of minimum 50 lakh or more from manufacturing . Audited balance sheet & Profit & loss statement of three financial years (i.e. 2022-23 & 2023-24 & 2024- 25 & 2025-26) should be provided to exhibit financial capability of the manufacturer. 13. The bidder/OEM should have successfully executed at least one order value of Rs. 50 lakh or more in a ny Central Govt. Department / State Govt. Department / PSU etc. during last 5 financial years of Hard coke items. The completion certificate along with the copy of Purchase Order and detailed BOQ should be enclos ed with tender bid. 14.Copy of income tax returns for the past three consecutive assessment years along with copy of PAN car d. 15. The Sample shall be submitted at least 5 days prior to the scheduled date of bid opening. .
